RAR decoder fixtures copied from koni_rar 0.9.0 (MIT):
https://github.com/zenbaku/koni_archive

- rar5.rar: test/fixtures/rar/normal.rar; stored text plus compressed nested/deep/data.bin (100,000 bytes).
- rar4.rar: test/fixtures/rar_static/solid_rar4.rar; five compressed text files sharing a solid dictionary.

These contain synthetic test data, not commercial ROMs. LICENSE preserves the upstream notice.
7z fixtures are generated by the tests with the package writer.

single_game.rar is a locally generated RAR4 stored archive with one synthetic ROM (bytes 1, 2, 3) under wrapper/Game.iso.
